attested_fields.integration_process: Cyber risks scored in Concord are mapped onto the enterprise risk taxonomy and consolidated into the quarterly ERM register maintained by the Chief Risk Officer.
attested_fields.erm_reporting: Top cyber risks are reported to the Board Risk Committee each quarter alongside financial, operational, and strategic risks using a common heat-map.
attested_fields.escalation_path: Risks breaching tolerance are escalated to the CRO within 5 business days and to the Board Risk Committee at the next scheduled meeting or sooner if material.
